overview: The Committee approved the Superintendent's annual goals and reviewed a new honors pilot for the vocational program following updates on the successful start of the 2026-2027 school year.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The Committee entered executive session to discuss a grievance with the Medford Teachers Association and strategy regarding potential litigation in Sheik, PPA v. City of Medford.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills, a $10,000 donation from Watts Water Technologies, and the August 24 minutes as amended to include the full text of a previous resolution.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Student Author
items.summary: The Superintendent introduced a McGlynn Elementary fourth-grader who recently published a book on Amazon.

items.title: CTE Honors Pilot Presentation
items.summary: Staff presented a new honors pilot for the Career Technical Education program allowing juniors and seniors in specific majors to earn honors credit through co-op employment or capstone projects.

items.title: Opening of Schools Update
items.summary: The Superintendent reported on new hires, enrollment trends, and a 68% reduction in the after-school program waitlist alongside summer facility and technology upgrades.

items.title: Superintendent's Goals 2026-2027
items.summary: Approved the Superintendent's goals for the academic year, focusing on early literacy benchmarks, middle school curriculum alignment, and the development of a new district strategic plan.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: The Committee expressed condolences to the families of Lorraine Miles, Gerald H. Wadness, and Derek McGuire before adjourning the meeting.
